data.text:
M/S Synthite Industries (P) Ltd vs Food Safety Officer 
Chengannur Circle on 3 September, 2024 
Author: K. Babu
Bench: K. Babu
 In The High Court Of Kerala At Ernakulam
 Present
 The Honourable Mr.Justice K. Babu
 Tuesday, the 3rd day of September 2024 / 12th Bhadra, 1946
 Crl.Mc No. 7215 Of 2024
Cc 2728/2023 Of Judicial Magistrate Of First Class -I, Chengannur, Alappuzha
Petitioner(S)Accused Nos.4 To 7:

 Panchayat,Vadavucodu, Ernakulam Represented By Its Nominee U/S 66
 Of The Fss Act Anil Kumar , Pin - 682310
 2. Anil Kumar, Aged 56 Years, S/O Kumaran Nair K Geetha Bhavan Konnakal
 P.O. Near Govt Lps Valakom, Muvattupuzha Representing M/S Synthite
 Industries (P) Ltd. Spices Division, Synthite Taste Park Building
 No. Ix/312A, 312B,312C,312D Pancodu,Aikarand Grama
 Panchayat,Vadavucodu, Ernakulam 682310, Pin - 682316
 3. Jacob Thomas, Aged 52 Years, Plantharayil, Vazharmangalam
 Chengannur, Alapuzha Representing Ms/ Intergrow Brands Pvt Ltd Ajay
 Vihar, M.G.Road, Cochin, Kerala 682016, Pin - 689121
 4. Ms/ Intergrow Brands Pvt Ltd Ajay Vihar, M.G.Road, Cochin, Kerala 
 Represented By Its Nominee U/S 66 Of The Fss Act Jacob Thomas , Pin
 - 682016
Respondent(S)Complainant, State & Another:
 1. Food Safety Officer Chengannur Circle, 1St Floor Mini Civil Station
 Chengannur , Pin - 689121
 2. State Of Kerala, Represented By Public Prosecutor, High Court Of
 Kerala, Pin - 682031
 3. The Food Safety And Standards Authority Of India, Science And
 Standards (S & S) Division, Fba Bhavan, Kotala Road, New Delhi
 Represented By Its Joint Director (Science And Standards.), Pin -
 110002
 This Criminal Misc. case coming on for orders, upon persuing the
petition and upon hearing the arguments of Sri.PREMJIT Nagendran,
Advocates for the petitioners and M/S Vaibhave Sharma,Amit Mehana Sc for
R3 ( -Served ON,)and Public PROSECUTOR,for R1 And R2 the court passed the
following:
 K.Babu, J.

1  ----------------------------------------
 Dated this the 3rd day of September, 2024  ORDER Admit.
2. The learned ADGP takes notice for respondent Nos. 1 and 2. Shri. Vaibhav Sharma and Shri. Amit Mehana, the learned Standing Counsel enter appearance for respondent No.3. 
3. Having regard to the orders produced as Annexure-F and on a consideration of the circumstances pointed out by the learned counsel, there will be an interim stay as prayed for, for a period of six months. 
Post along with Crl.M.C.No.962 of 2023. 
Sd/-
